source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: You are deploying an agent to work on a project folder. Which setup follows the lecture's guidance?

options.text: Give task-appropriate access and check important results
options.feedback: The tools and working area should fit the task. Inspecting important results checks whether the work actually satisfies the goal.

options.text: Grant broad access after the model gives one reassuring answer
options.feedback: A reassuring response does not demonstrate reliable behavior across tasks or justify unnecessary authority.

options.text: Rely on a detailed skill to create any permissions it needs
options.feedback: Instructions describe a procedure. They do not create access that the surrounding environment has not granted.

options.text: Choose the largest model and trust its report that actions succeeded
options.feedback: Model size and a success statement do not replace checking tool outcomes and finished artifacts.
